definitions.local_button_helpers: style-returning const arrow factories with Btn/Button in the name, plus HoverBtn, in studio/*.jsx; ds/ is the shared owner
definitions.inline_styles: literal JSX style={{...}} attributes in studio/*.jsx; ds/ is the shared owner
definitions.http_servers: modules that construct an HTTP server (HTTPServer/ThreadingHTTPServer/uvicorn.run/web.run_app)
definitions.graph_authorities: modules that open the universal graph sqlite store directly (sqlite3.connect on a *universal*.sqlite3 path or class *GraphStore/*CellStore)
definitions.revit_adapters: modules defining Revit execution adapters (def/class names with 'revit' + exec/adapter/bridge)
definitions.baboom_loops: functions named like a BABOOM agent/tool loop (baboom.*loop|run_.*tool_loop)
definitions.settings_stores: modules that persist settings outside the graph (json dump to *settings*.json / QSettings)
definitions.model_routers: modules defining a model router (class/def *Router or route_model)
definitions.unimported_modules: nodelang/*.py never imported by any other file in the tree (excluding __init__, __main__, tests, entry scripts)
definitions.placeholder_strings: UI/runtime strings 'Not available yet' / 'coming soon' / 'placeholder' / 'TODO' in nodelang (non-test)
definitions.dead_params_known: dead params from the R&D inventory still declared (default_view, default_tab, speech_budget_per_hour, tick_cadence_minutes)
